convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'AroonOscillatorSignAlert' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution (position open/close, money management, global variable handling, IsNewBar class). Custom indicator logic is opaque and must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed before indicator is valid
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open gating

other_exits: Exit long when AroonOscillatorSignAlert buffer 0 (Down signal) is non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE on a historical bar scan (if BuyPosClose enabled)
Exit short when AroonOscillatorSignAlert buffer 1 (Up signal) is non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE on a historical bar scan (if SellPosClose enabled)

Historical bar scan from SignalBar+1 forward looking for opposing signal to confirm close, only when both open and close booleans are enabled for a side and no close signal found on the current signal bar

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum from TradeAlgorithms.mqh: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=lot), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses. When MMMode=LOT, MM is interpreted as fixed lots. Otherwise MM is a fractional coefficient applied to the selected margin base.

custom_logic_notes: Entry signals are read from SignalBar=1 (previous completed bar), not bar 0. When both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose are enabled and no close signal found on the signal bar, the EA scans forward through historical bars to find an opposing signal to trigger close. UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime are calculated as last bar date + TimeShiftSec, used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh to gate position opening (prevents duplicate entries within same bar). GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit to clean up. LoadHistory() ensures sufficient bar data is loaded before processing. The ATR_Period=14 is declared as a non-input variable (uint, not input), so it cannot be changed by the user at runtime - this may be a bug or intentional default.
python_conversion_notes: The custom indicator AroonOscillatorSignAlert must be reimplemented in Python (Aroon Oscillator with signal alerts at +/-50 levels). TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles all trade execution including money management modes, position open/close with deviation, global variable cleanup, and IsNewBar detection - all must be reimplemented. The Aroon Oscillator itself is standard: Aroon Up = 100*(period-highest_high_offset)/period, Aroon Down = 100*(period-lowest_low_offset)/period, Aroon Oscillator = Aroon Up - Aroon Down. Signal logic: buy when oscillator > UpLevel(+50), sell when oscillator < DnLevel(-50). The historical bar scan for opposing close signals adds complexity - it scans from SignalBar+1 forward through all bars to find the first opposing signal, which must be replicated exactly. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so no digit adjustment is applied - the values are passed directly to TradeAlgorithms.mqh. Deviation is also in points.
